finding: A reader who selects OpenCode can look for three placeholder rows that the installer never writes. The model reference, first-session tutorial, and local configuration inventory describe placeholders for each selected CLI. init-factory accepts OpenCode but provides no OpenCode stanza. A generator check with only OpenCode selected produced no tier rows. Qualify the claim in all three pages to cover selected CLIs with model routing.
why_this_severity: OpenCode is guard-only, and the installer writes the documented placeholders for all four model-routed CLIs (no to fails_purpose). The wording can send readers looking for rows they will never need.
